crossRefs.note: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all…
He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.
But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
“I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments…
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his…

translations.web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
translations.bsb: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
translations.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
translations.asv: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame.
